scripts.studio: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.still: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts Trailer
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer out/gta-bogota-trailer.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --concurrency=8
scripts.render:vertical: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts TrailerVertical out/gta-bogota-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=8
scripts.render:draft: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer out/draft.mp4 --scale=0.5 --crf=28 --concurrency=8
